title: Convergence of Markovian Iteration for $Z$-Coupled FBSDEs via Gaussian Smoothing
abstract: arXiv:2504.02814v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: In this paper, we investigate the Markovian iteration method for coupled forward-backward stochastic differential equations (FBSDEs) with drift $b(t,X_t,Y_t,Z_t)$ and deterministic, time-dependent diffusion. Bender and Zhang (2008) established convergence results for Markovian iteration in the $Y$-coupled setting. Extending these results to equations with $Z$-coupling presents additional challenges, particularly in obtaining uniform control of the spatial Lipschitz constants of the discrete decoupling fields across iterations and time steps.   We address this difficulty by representing the discrete $Z$-field through the spatial derivative of the Gaussian-smoothed $Y$-field. This representation, combined with weak differentiation, yields uniform spatial Lipschitz bounds for both discrete decoupling fields without requiring their classical second derivatives. translated_title: 基于高斯平滑的 $Z$-耦合正倒向随机微分方程（FBSDEs）的马尔可夫迭代收敛性
translated_abstract: 本文研究了具有漂移项 $b(t,X_t,Y_t,Z_t)$ 以及确定性、时变扩散系数的耦合正倒向随机微分方程（FBSDEs）的马尔可夫迭代方法。Bender 和 Zhang（2008）已在 $Y$-耦合的情形下建立了马尔可夫迭代的收敛性结果。然而，将这些结果推广到具有 $Z$-耦合的方程会带来额外的挑战，尤其是在跨迭代和时间步对离散解耦场的空间 Lipschitz 常数进行一致控制方面。我们通过利用高斯平滑后的 $Y$-场的空间导数来表示离散 $Z$-场，从而解决了这一困难。这种表示方法与弱求导技术相结合，在无需经典二阶导数的情况下，为两个离散解耦场给出了统一的空间 Lipschitz 界。在适当的压缩条件下，我们证明了马尔可夫迭代的收敛性。
tldr: 该论文通过用高斯平滑后的 $Y$-场的空间导数表示离散 $Z$-场并结合弱求导技术，在不需要经典二阶导数的条件下，首次在适当的压缩条件下证明了 $Z$-耦合 FBSDE 马尔可夫迭代的收敛性，克服了离散解耦场空间 Lipschitz 常数一致控制的难题。
en_tdlr: By representing the discrete $Z$-field through the spatial derivative of the Gaussian-smoothed $Y$-field combined with weak differentiation, this paper overcomes the challenge of uniformly controlling spatial Lipschitz constants and proves convergence of Markovian iteration for $Z$-coupled FBSDEs under suitable contraction conditions without requiring classical second derivatives.
